usedFor: Cliengo captures chat contacts, and Pipedrive stores them as people when “New Customer/Contact” runs “Create Person”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer/Contact” in Cliengo, then “Create Person” in Pipedrive
bestTemplate.why: Every contact the chatbot collects becomes a Pipedrive person, with email and phone ready for your sales team.

watchOut: “New Customer/Contact” in Cliengo is polling, so “Create Person” runs after a scheduled check, not at once.
